text: ગંગા અને ઉમા સગી બહેનો હતાં.
hook_to_payoff: Main loop (how were the Ganga and Uma sisters, and how did one of them become the river of three paths?) answers in scenes 3–4 (Himavan and Mena's two daughters, the Ganga the elder), turns at the verse card (scene 6, Himavan gives the Ganga away for the good of the three worlds), pays off the river's half at scene 7 (the gods carry her to heaven) and closes at scene 10, when the sage names both daughters, the Ganga and Uma Devi, at about 88–91% of runtime. The Ep09 question (how did she cross three worlds?) is answered for her first path only, and scene 11 opens the rest. The next-episode question is not counted as the payoff.
